title: Patient or service segmentation using clustering
purpose: Uses standardized features and k-means clustering to identify groups with different utilization, risk, cost, or workflow patterns.
input: `Data` sheet with id plus numeric features; `Parameters` sheet with number of clusters and random starts.
outputs: Cluster assignments, cluster profiles, explained variance diagnostics, two-dimensional visualization, and segment interpretation.
limitations: This is an educational example. It is not a clinical device, validated decision instrument, or substitute for local statistical, economic, legal, privacy, cybersecurity, ethics, quality, or health-technology-assessment review.
